Visitor formats definition lists with custom templates

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitDefinitionDescription(NodeContext ctx, String text) {
                return new VisitResult.Custom(String.format("> %s", text));
            }
            @Override public VisitResult visitDefinitionTerm(NodeContext ctx, String text) {
                return new VisitResult.Custom(String.format("### %s", text));
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<dl><dt>Python</dt><dd>A high-level programming language</dd><dt>JavaScript</dt><dd>A scripting language for web browsers</dd></dl>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
